answer: Each identity locks a 90-credit ferrous bond and files one input-output sheet. Each output needs a ferrous-stamped receipt keyed to the filer and job. An auditor recomputes the delta between receipted inputs and claimed outputs; a delta beyond the 5 percent ridge burns the bond. Audit fee: 20 for the first, 20 plus 10 times k minus 1 for the kth, 10010 for the thousandth. 1000 fakes lock 90000 and pay 5015000 in fees. A rented-receipt ring fails: a receipt reused under a second key voids both sheets and bonds. An honest worker files once, pays 110, and gets the bond back.
